notes.title: Alpha V06 is on the way!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28229455/2386de90a5bd8ea76f4c635f2cea3ef634a1e5f3.gif[/img]

Hey pilots,

Alpha v06 is just around the corner! This is a major update and I'm thankful for your patience so far! This time I'm introducing the Rogue Wings' Open Universe: a living and breathing star system full of friendlies and foes, planets, moons, asteroid fields and space stations for you to explore! This is how you will now enter missions and take part as the story progresses.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28229455/4c241d106b5a1d563fa90d3cf0a0f6b261520db6.gif[/img]

A word of caution: this star system is under attack by the evil Supremacy forces, and each space lane jump might trigger an encounter! In the most dangerous areas you'll face drone squadrons, pirate ships and even Supremacy Battleships! 

The new flight model is also coming together really well! This is a complete overhaul over the original Rogue Wings flight model, and it brings more responsive turning and the ability to roll with ease. Flying now is way more satisfying, as your ship will respond a lot better to your commands.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28229455/a4e2d3c6807013cc4d8f69c063f70ff936a08298.gif[/img]

You will also notice major performance improvements. A lot of the game base code went through some serious optimization and I can now throw a lot more enemies in and increase the scale of combat considerably!

That's it for today! It's almost time to jump into the pilot's seat!

notes.title: Recap - January 2018
notes.content:
Hello fellow pilots,

The new year is here and with it comes a new update announcement for Nightstar: Rogue Wings! Today we’re taking a quick look at a few of the new features you should expect to see on the upcoming v06!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28229455/cbfb8f989a3a30755bf637aa9d87c29368216e06.gif[/img]

[h1]Flight Model Overhaul[/h1]

The flight model has been completely redone and that means some change in Rogue Wings’ core gameplay. With responsive turning and the ability to to roll with ease, flying should now be way more satisfying. Full loops are now possible thanks to the gimbal-lock free flight model. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28229455/ce02a93976454591dacb11bb3a40d713fc046d72.gif[/img]

[h1]Weapons And Upgrades[/h1]

Following the community’s suggestions I was able to come up with a few improvements for v06. You will now be able to find, craft and equip an extensive variety of weapons - from projectile-based machineguns to Star Wars-like laser guns. The different weapons will cover a broad range of different gameplay styles and will give you the right tools to fight the Supremacy. Get ready for some serious PEW PEW!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28229455/275ed8b29bc3ed1883d7d9cc8cb7a32857597a40.gif[/img]

[h1]Visuals and Performance[/h1]

As we’re moving closer to the full release of Nightstar: Rogue Wings, a few performance improvements have taken place and that allows for the game to run smoother than ever. This is an ongoing improvement and you can expect a few more patches to the performance from now on. This update also brings a completely redesigned GUI and extensive updates to the player’s ship model.

There’s a lot more to be said about the Alpha v06, and as you may have noticed, I’m keeping some surprises for my next update. Please stay tuned! I’ll see you on the air!

notes.title: 0.41 HOTFIX! Addressing the Lock.
notes.content:
Hi all! Dev here. 

You'll notice Steam downloading a small patch for NIGHTSTAR: Rogue Wings today. That's the hotfix for 0.41, or how I like to call it "bye-bye auto-follow".

As indie developers, we're experimenting with different game mechanics and trying out new formulas. Sometimes, that results in us finding really cool new gameplay elements that completely changes the game (Rage Attack!), but sometimes we miss the mark. This is what happened to the lock-on mechanic.

Now we're back to regular aiming, and the player's ship will no longer auto-follow enemies when target locked.

Please give it a try and let me know your thoughts!

notes.title: NIGHTSTAR: Rogue Wings v0.41a is out!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28229455/eaccb220ea1a606798e4524ce9422d03ee52efb8.jpg[/img]

Hello pilots! Dev here. It's Steam Summer Sale time and to celebrate we're putting out a fresh update for NIGHTSTAR: Rogue Wings! For those who are following the game from up close, you have already probably noticed some of the changes on a stealth update that happened a few days ago. Now, let's take a quick look at what's changed on v0.41a.

[list]
    [*][b]Controller, controller, controller.[/b] Again, I'm working hard to polish the controls. You'll notice that some keys have changed, as we're getting ready to implement the key mapper. Also, there's a quick control reminder on the beginning of each level, and it also shows up when you switch from keyboard to gamepad. On that note, gamepad support is still experimental and there'll be a patch very soon that improves the use of xbox and playstation 4 controllers.
    [*][b]New level![/b] The 4th level is in! This is our favorite level so far because of how varied the objectives are. The level is still being tested, so expect some bugs. I'll be polishing this level in the near future, so expect a patch for that too.
    [*][b]New cockpit is in![/b] The new cockpit is now functional, and now it's possible to use the free-look key when inside the ship.
    [*][b]New LASER weapon[/b] We've changed how the disruptors work. Now, all disruptor weapons are laser based, and piercing rounds are projectile based.
    [*][b]Upgrades![/b] Super cool new upgrades are in. You can pick these up during levels, and they can give you different weapons for a certain amount of time (or until its ammo runs out). These upgrades can also replenish your shield, health, or give you an extra life. If anyone can find out what game inspired us for these upgrades, feel free to comment below!
[*][b]Orbital Blockade level updates[/b] As always, there are a few updates on every level, but the Orbital Blockade is the STAR of v0.41a. Take a look at it in-game, it's looking gorgeous!
[*][b]General bug fixes[/b] Ah, Early Access. We're bug hunting like crazy, and a lot of the things that were bothering us and the players are now fixed! Yay for smooth gameplay!
[/list]

That's it for today! Let Steam download the updates for you, and give the game a try. And if you are interested on this project and still didn't pick it up, there's a 10% OFF discount right now! So go for it. And don't forget to participate on the community forums here on Steam, we're always there listening to feedback and talking to players.

Cheers, and have fun!

notes.title: NIGHTSTAR: Rogue Wings v0.3a is out!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28229455/5dbbfba281d165a133b12f79217f0c77ab86147f.gif[/img]

Hi all! Dev here. Today is a big day, as I'm pushing the 0.3 update to main branch and it comes with many, many new things.

I was actually planning on sending this update only to some game journalists I contacted, BUT I decided to release it to the general public because, you know, this is Early Access! :)

So let's cut straight to the change log (compact version). Here's what changed:

[list]
[*][b]Clean post processing.[/b] This was a big one, requested by many. Now the game doesn't look like it's being played through a dirty pair of goggles!
[*][b]Performance increase.[/b] You'll notice some frame rate gain as a result from many small tweaks on many things.
[*][b]Massive controller update.[/b] Yep, controllers changed BIG TIME. I could write an entire changelog just on this aspect, but I'll try to keep this short. At this moment, [b]I strongly recommend playing Rogue Wings on mouse + keyboard.[/b] That being said, xbox and playstation controllers should be working [i]mostly[/i] fine. You might still have to use the mouse to interact with menus, and this is something I'm planning on fixing in the future. There's also [B]EXPERIMENTAL[/b] support for Flightsticks. Try it at your own rist - it's still very, very basic and unreliable.
[*][b]Gameplay improvements.[/b] The most arcade-y movements of all times are finally in. You can now double tap A or D to roll, double tap W to [i]PHASE[/i] and double tap S to [i]perform an 180 turn[/i]. This changes the game's dynamic immensely and is also a lot of fun. This leads us to the next point...
[*][b]Balancing.[/b] Because of all the gameplay and control changes, and basically because now it's easier to control your ship, I made enemies a little more aggressive. If someone shoots a homing missile at you, you will [i]have to[/i] do something to get out of its way. My favorite is using the Phase, followed by an 180 turn to counter-attack. Your wingmen also deal much more damage now.
[*][b]New hero ship![/b] You probably noticed how the entire promotional material changed since the last update. I've pulled the trigger on a new ship model, and now we are officially [b]no longer using assets from the Unreal Engine's Marketplace![/b] I personally love the new ship.
[*][b]RAGE![/b] You are a bad-ass pilot looking for revenge and stuff. So you obviously can accumulate RAGE and unleash it upon your enemies. Watch them look at you in the eye while you ROCKET-JUMP out of your cockpit with a massive rocket launcher in your hands. Fire up to 5 missiles directly into your target, or use the Secondary Weapon button to launch the [b][i]big one[/i][/b]. Keep an eye on your RAGE meter, right next to your health bar, and make sure to press SPACE to use it when it's filled up.
[*][b]Menus.[/b] There's an entire new Options Menu, and that's still a work in progress. Make sure to take a look at the control layouts for reference. When in doubt, press pause and go to options. Scroll down a bit to see the keyboard layout and learn what each key does.
[/list]

OK, there's still a lot more to add to this list, but these are the most important changes. Make sure to try the FREE CAMERA by holding LEFT ALT and moving your mouse. Also, please remember this is only the first big update since the Early Access launch, so if you encounter any bug, have gameplay suggestions or concerns, or feel like saying anything about the game, please come to the Community Hub forums here on Steam. I'm always there answering players' questions.

notes.title: NIGHTSTAR: Rogue Wings v0.2a is out!
notes.content:
Hi all, Dev here! Just a quick note about today's update. I've migrated the project to Unreal Engine 4.15, and that's a big thing. This will pave the way for great new things such as proper joystick and flight stick support.

Here's are the patch notes for this update, mostly gameplay stuff and a little bit of content changes:

[list]
[*] More responsive mouse controls.
[*] Major update to the LOCK-ON mechanics.
[*] Updates on the cockpit model and camera.
[*] Updated tone mapper. Graphics will look more realistic from now on.
[*] Depth of field effect greatly decreased.
[*] Improved texture streaming.
[*] Tardira Tower's health increased by 200%.
[*] Multiple mission bug fixes.
[/list]

That's it for today. Fly safe!

notes.title: A few words about NIGHTSTAR: Rogue Wings and the Early Access route
notes.content:
Hi all, Dev here! Last night, I released the Nightstar: Rogue Wings Early Access here on Steam. I'd like to make some comments on the feedback I'm getting, and I'd also like to thank everyone that is communicating their likes and dislikes about the game so far.

First thing is: please keep in mind that when buying an Early Access title, you are buying into much more than just a game. This is your opportunity to be a part of this game's development, and every comment you post here about the game will be taken very seriously - my goal is, after all, to make a great game for you guys.

That being said, I would strongly recommend buying a copy of this game on it's current stage [b]if you wish to be a part of this process[/b]. Again, I take community feedback very seriously and your voice will be heard.

Alright! Now let's talk about some points the players are making about Nightstar: Rogue Wings. I'm noticing that some players are expecting this game to be something that it is not: an open world space simulator. This game is an [b]arcade shooter[/b] and that will never change. There are many options for space simulators out there - Nightstar: Rogue Wings is not one of those. I'm working on updating the game's description to make this very clear, I don't want anyone buying the game only to see that it's not what they expected.

So, what is this game like? It's a classic arcade shooter, with delimited stages and clear objectives. When your ship explodes, you lose a life. If you lose too many lifes, then it's game over and you'll have to start that level from the beginning again.

"What makes this game different and why should I care?"
I'm trying new things here and I know that this is a risky move. For NIGHTSTAR, I created a new flight model gameplay that innovative and different from other flying games - and even though that's exciting, it also offers some obstacles. I see that players are having a hard time to control the ship, because it's simply different from everything they are used to. 

Right now, I'm certain that the tutorial level is not doing a good job at teaching the player how to play the game, and that leads to immediate frustration. I think this is one of the most important issues with the game on its current state - for that reason, I'm rethinking the entire tutorial level and you'll see an updated version of it hit Steam really soon.

That's all for now. Please be sure to send me any feedback you have about the game. As a developer, I believe the user's experience is 100% why I make games and I really want to deliver the best game I can.

Thanks again for all the feedback so far, and fly safe!
